answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to solve a willow protocol challenge to verify human-aligned uniqueness. By anchoring digital identities to a physical terrace of biometric data, the system forces attackers to incur massive hardware costs, essentially pouring an ocean of capital into verified nodes. This creates a prohibitive barrier where the cost of generating one thousand fake identities outweighs the potential utility gained by compromising the network consensus.
